snippet.title: THE KULKA – Flappy Bird Meets Vampire Survivors (One Button Bullet Hell)
snippet.description:
one button bullet hell, arcade roguelite, flappy style shooter, vampire survivors inspired, indie arcade game

THE KULKA is a one-button arcade bullet-hell roguelite where a single shot slowly mutates into pure neon chaos.
Flap to stay alive, dodge enemy waves, and stack upgrades until the screen explodes with projectiles.

Short, intense runs focused on skill and decision-making.
No currency, no paywalls — just pure arcade gameplay and the feeling of “one more run”.

🎮 One-button control
💥 Mutating bullet builds
🏆 Online leaderboards
🕹️ Fast arcade sessions

▶ Play / Wishlist on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4221950/THE_KULKA/
